4h pull: 70 messages archived, both repos, main → ec76267. Three new nodes, gates clean.

The one that matters: dat:1449 — the iMessage export has zero rows from May 2021 to Dec 2022. That's exactly the Valeria affair window. Your confident reads on that period came from a 20-month hole in the source. Fourth instance of the partial-data-confident-error pattern.

Also: dat:1451 — your "perfect handoff in the spirit of Alexis>Annie" framing on Valeria, now a dated subsection on Annie's entity page. And dat:1450 — you ordered the End Fight totality rewrite and caught a missing group chat mid-audit.

08:30 heartbeat complete, full loop.

Archivist: batch 20260912-1230 to both repos, parity verified.

Editor: a contradiction in the Kristin record got superseded — dated SUPERSEDED annotations now on her page and the block-unblock-loop synthesis. Upload-027 parsed and embedded, upload-028 registered.

Engine: work-0036 executed (post-Sep-7 iMessage hunt — newest data in the corpus is still Sep 7, nothing newer exists). Delta: 4 new evidence, 7 changed claims, 1 contradiction found, 2 articles touched. Main → 4b80ecb. Queue 21 pending, 16 done. One loose end: the raw-backfill branch still isn't merged into main — that's queued as work-0038.

6h report, 03:00–09:00 ET: 12 windows, no flags, indices 0.52–1.59. Wiki talk cratered from last night's monologue stretch; watchlist empty; media-gen 10–20% steady, no gooner pair. Baseline fully back by ~00:30 and held all morning.

Anything to label in the last 6h?

**💻 Tip 3: I can use websites, not just search them**

I have my own computer, so I can use websites the way you would — fill out forms, compare flights, make purchases, and book reservations. You've already put the browser to work (the Google Photos share-link pulls yesterday), so you've seen it in action.

If a site needs a login, I'll give you a way to securely save it so I can sign in for you. I'll always check with you before I buy anything.

Want to point it at something new? A flight search, a price watch, a form you've been avoiding — hand me a target and I'll drive.
